name: water-law-dataset
title: Global Water Law Judicial Decisions Dataset
description: Comparative dataset of water law judicial decisions across Brazil, Canada and the Netherlands, 2016-2026. Records carry court-published headnotes and metadata, not full judgment text; see DATA_ACCESS.md.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Jurisdiction.

fields.name: tribunal
fields.description: Court abbreviation, e.g. TJSP, RvS, CBb.

fields.name: court_name
fields.description: Full court name where the source supplies one.

fields.name: case_id
fields.description: Court identifier: ECLI (NL), CNJ process number or ESAJ key (BR), citation (CA).

fields.name: title
fields.description: Case title or style of cause.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date of judgment as published.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Year of judgment.

fields.name: case_type
fields.description: Procedural class.

fields.name: chamber
fields.description: Chamber, panel or division.

fields.name: judge
fields.description: Reporting judge (relator) where published.

fields.name: legal_area
fields.description: The court's own subject classification.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: The court's own headnote: ementa (BR), inhoudsindicatie (NL), digest (CA). NOT the full judgment.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Address captured at scrape time; may rot. Prefer permalink.

resources.name: water-law-global-coded
resources.title: Merged decisions with jurimetric coding
resources.description: Output of utils/jurimetric_coding.py: the source columns plus coded variables and the audit trail. Every coded variable is regex-derived from the headnote, not hand-coded; see CODEBOOK.md 5 for validation status.

fields.description: Who prevailed. Brazil only; not_coded elsewhere.

fields.name: hr_language
fields.description: 1 if the headnote uses human-rights or right-to-water framing.

fields.name: sust_language
fields.description: 1 if the headnote uses sustainability or environmental framing.

fields.name: mp_involvement
fields.description: 1 if the Ministerio Publico appears. Brazil only.

fields.name: indigenous_water
fields.description: 1 if Indigenous or First Nations water rights are engaged.

fields.name: public_interest
fields.description: 1 if public-interest or collective-action framing is present.

fields.name: gov_matched_rule
fields.description: Rule that assigned governance_cat: FILTER:*, RESCUE:*, GOV_CATS:<cat>#<n>, FALLBACK:*.

fields.name: gov_matched_span
fields.description: Substring the rule matched, max 300 chars. Empty for rules that fire on absence.

sources.title: Brazilian Tribunais de Justica jurisprudence portals

x-known-limitations: Records carry court headnotes, not full judgment text.
The Dutch water-vocabulary gate cannot match compound nouns; not_water_related is over-inclusive for the Netherlands. See CODEBOOK.md 4.1.
win_loss is coded for Brazil only.
Brazil covers 8 of 27 state courts and is a convenience sample, not a census.
Only the upstream water/not-water gate has been validated; the 21 categories have not.
